subject: feat(ssh_dotnet): add file-picker ("...") editor for the private key file property
body:
feat(ssh_dotnet): add file-picker ("...") editor for the private key file property

Add SshPrivateKeyFileEditor (a UITypeEditor) so the Private Key File property in the
connection property grid shows a "..." browse button that opens the standard Windows
OpenFileDialog, filtered to common private-key file types (PEM, *.key, *.ppk, OpenSSH
id_* keys, plus All files for extensionless keys).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Current SSH protocols already use PrivateKeyPath plus an OpenFileDialog editor; the candidate targets absent SshDotNet-specific properties.
